summary: Commerce platform for building and running online stores, with apps extending the merchant admin and storefront.
access_note: Free dev stores and custom apps via Dev Dashboard; public multi-store apps need App Store registration and review.
blocker_note: Public distribution to many stores requires Shopify App Store approval; custom distribution is limited to a single store.

evidence.quote: Your app sends the token in the X-Shopify-Access-Token header on every GraphQL Admin API request.
Authorization code grant , for apps that run outside the Shopify admin.
You own them, for building and testing without touching a live store.
Public distribution also requires registering for the Shopify App Store, which has a one-time fee.
The REST Admin API is a legacy API as of October 1, 2024.
Starting April 1, 2025, all new public apps must be built exclusively with the GraphQL Admin API .
If you prefer MCP, you can connect to Shopify's developer resources through the Dev MCP server.

notes: MCP is Shopify Dev MCP (local, docs/dev tooling, no auth), not a store-operations server. REST Admin API is legacy; GraphQL is primary.
